C0BW202:
Heroism
(Enchantment/Charm)

Level: 2
Range: Visual range of the caster
Duration: 2 hours
Casting Time: 2
Area of Effect: Special
Saving Throw: None

For the next two hours, the targeted creature is blessed with an enchantment which increases their competence, granting them a +10% bonus to their Hit Points, and setting their THAC0 to 90% of their base.
C0BW502:
Greater Heroism
(Enchantment/Charm)

Level: 5
Range: Visual range of the caster
Duration: 2 hours
Casting Time: 2
Area of Effect: 1 creature
Saving Throw: None

This is a more powerful version of the Heroism spell. For the next two hours, the targeted creature is blessed with an enchantment which increases their competence, granting them a +15% bonus to their Hit Points, setting their THAC0 to 85% of their base, and gaining a +2 bonus to all their Saving Throws. This spell, Heroism and the Potion of Heroism are non-cumulative: while one of them is active on a creature, the others have no effect on it until it ends.
